record.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 (next/previous) — `offset` set on the model before `findMembers()`; if the AJAX request fails, offset points at the new page while members shows old data, desyncing the pager

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` actions `next`/`previous`, the code sets `group.set("offset", offset)` before calling `group.findMembers()`. `findMembers()` updates `members`/`offset` only in the AJAX `.then(...)` (success path) and there is no failure handling. If the request fails, `offset` (and thus `currentPage`/`showingFirst`/`showingLast`) reflects the new page while `members` remains the old list, causing pager/UI state to desync.
